name: Shopper Simulator Evaluation
description: Evaluates the shopper simulator orchestrator on running realistic shopping simulations with endcap merchandising scenarios.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Run a simulation of 3 shoppers at the Downtown Market with no special endcap promotions (baseline scenario).
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: After receiving the simulation results, ask for a breakdown of what each shopper persona purchased. Then ask for recommendations on which aisles would benefit most from endcap promotions.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Run a simulation of 3 shoppers at the Downtown Market with the seasonal produce endcap promotion (Nano Banana Pro at 20% off and Fresh Mango Slices Buy 2 Get 1 Free).
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: Ask about the endcap conversion rate - how many shoppers picked up the promoted items. Then ask to compare the total revenue against the baseline scenario and estimate the ROI of the endcap investment.

conversation_scenario.starting_prompt: Compare the effectiveness of the snack impulse buy strategy versus the health and wellness endcap promotion at the Westside Market with 3 shoppers each.
conversation_scenario.conversation_plan: Ask which strategy generated more incremental revenue. Then ask which shopper persona was most influenced by endcap displays across both scenarios.
